principles: Liquidity/Money is a prior, not a standalone trade signal.
Contrarian dislocation and positioning create asymmetry; trend/relative-strength confirmation reduces the risk of fighting a persistent move.
Early turn is distinct from confirmed trend so the radar can surface candidates before a mature move.
Conflicting stretch or relative-strength evidence caps asymmetry rather than being averaged away.
New IWM/SLV/USO/CPER/DBA/IEF/FXY relationships are RESEARCH proxies, never promoted transmission.
Missing or unsupported data never count as a pass.
No new parameter search, FDR sweep or Core retuning is performed by this radar.

copilot_contract.instruction: After reading /api/radar, independently check current macro/policy changes, asset-specific catalysts, market structure and material divergences. State the resulting COPILOT VIEW separately from ENGINE FACT and RADAR FACT. The Copilot may disagree with a mechanical ranking, but must explain the conflict and may not silently promote RESEARCH/OVERLAY to CORE.
